g.text: EPFL | Best training score by round
Four configurations · cumulative best over the seed and all formal submissions
All four configurations: 20 completed rounds, 40 formal candidates each. No extrapolation.
Seed score = 100. Y-axis starts at 99. Training only; individual worker scores and local trial scores are not plotted.
